text: This solution, Nepal’s Government-led Earthquake Risk Reduction and Mitigation Initiatives (2020–2025) addresses natural catastrophe in Nepal between National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Authority (NDRRMA), Ministry of Home Affairs (MoHA), Ministry of Federal Affairs and General Administration (MoFAGA), National Council for Disaster Risk Reduction and Management (NCDRRM), World Bank, USAID/Nepal, UN Country Team, ESCAP, and UN agencies designated as Provincial Focal Point Agencies (PFPAs). The program was implemented in 2020 and focuses on collaboration, raising awareness, and accessibility.
